# Change

Describe the problem and the behaviour this change introduces.

## Validation

List the relevant checks and their results.

## User impact

Describe any changes to communication preferences, accessibility, privacy or
existing client behaviour.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change preserves meaning, exact values and user choice.
- [ ] Examples and logs contain synthetic or appropriately redacted data.
- [ ] Relevant documentation, regression coverage and citations are updated.
